item.title: Hubble 2.0.18
item.description:
Hubble 2.0.18 gives each Button Matrix tab its own worksheet and improves responsiveness during CCC saves.
- Matrix tabs have their own row positions, action columns, and layout settings. Button IDs stay stable, and existing formulas migrate to the new sheet coordinates. Workspace export and full-workbook copy preserve sheet layouts. - CCC button requests can continue while module document saves finish in order. Compact save confirmations keep the Matrix editor responsive during rapid selections. - Modules can provide a full-page sidebar frontend with their own tabs and scrolling. Developer Kit 1.8.0 includes a working example.
This update is optional.
